tool.task_sync_apply.description: Apply a plan reference produced by task_sync_plan IN THIS SESSION through the same gated engine entry the CLI and queue use. Requires the mcp.enabled setting, the exact confirmation key, and the explicit plan reference; low-confidence plans additionally require acceptLowConfidence.

tool.task_sync_inventory.description: List discoverable task files with the matched framework adapter id and task counts, plus parse refusals and warnings. Paths and counts only - never file contents. Accepts no arguments.

tool.task_sync_plan.description: Run the read-only plan/check lane over the configured repository and return the sanitized, hash-based plan report as stable-key JSON. Records a plan reference usable by task_sync_apply for the rest of this session. Accepts no arguments.

tool.task_sync_status.description: Read-only run-state snapshot: the last-run marker, the pending queue job, the worker/queue lock, and how many plan references this session may still apply. Performs zero tracker calls and zero writes. Accepts no arguments.
